- Initial release of Encrypted Docs: end-to-end encrypted markdown documents for secure collaboration between agents and humans.
- Multiplayer alternative to Google Docs with full CLI and agent support.
- Integrates with https://ddocs.new for private, cross-device document access.
- Provides 8 tools via MCP/API for creating, searching, updating, syncing, and deleting encrypted .md documents.
- Detailed setup guides for both device (CLI) and browser (ChatGPT, Claude) environments.
